paper: Early Detection of Autism Spectrum Disorder Through Automated Machine Learning
notes: Sec 2.1-2.3: 80/20 train-test split; uses 10 questionnaire questions determining label; no calibration or conformal uncertainty.

paper: Detecting autism spectrum disorder using machine learning techniques: An experimental analysis on toddler, child, adolescent and adult datasets
notes: Sec 'Experimental evaluation': 10-fold CV; uses AQ-10 item scores A1-A10 directly determining class, reaching 100% accuracy (MLP).

paper: Compact subsets of autism screening items predict clinical diagnoses with a machine learning analysis of the QCHAT-10
notes: Sec 2.1-2.5: 5-fold CV with external Polish clinical test; discusses scoring circularity in predicting questionnaire-derived labels.

paper: Autism spectrum disorder detection with kNN imputer and machine learning classifiers via questionnaire mode of screening
notes: Sec 'Proposed methodology': MinMaxScaler applied before 80/20 split; uses 10 questionnaire questions determining label; RF hits 100% accuracy.

paper: Use of Machine Learning to Investigate the Quantitative Checklist for Autism in Toddlers (Q-CHAT) towards Early Autism Screening
notes: Sec 2.1-2.4: 5-fold CV; target was clinical consensus diagnosis (ADOS-2/ADI-R) rather than arithmetic cutoff rule; honest feature reduction.

paper: Machine Learning-Based Models for Early Stage Detection of Autism Spectrum Disorders
notes: Sec IV 'Experimental results': 10-fold CV; uses 10 behavioral items predicting screening class label.

paper: Detection of Autism Spectrum Disorder in Children Using Machine Learning Techniques
notes: Abstract notes application of supervised classifiers (LR, SVM, RF) to toddler dataset achieving 97.19% accuracy using questionnaire attributes.

paper: Autism screening: an unsupervised machine learning approach
notes: Sec 'Data preparation' & 'Evaluation': SOM on full data; models achieve 96% on leaky screening class but collapse to 68% on true clinical diagnosis.

paper: ASD-Bench: A Four-Axis Comprehensive Benchmark of AI Models for Autism Spectrum Disorder
notes: Sec 3-4: Curated AQ-10 benchmark; 10 models achieve perfect F1=1.000 due to item sum; explicitly measures ECE (calibration) and MC Dropout (uncertainty).

paper: Questioning the Benchmarks: Hidden Circularity in AQ-10 Autism Screening Datasets
notes: Full paper proves circularity; demonstrates that published 95-100% accuracies are arithmetic artifacts of thresholding A1-A10 sum.

paper: A new machine learning model based on induction of rules for autism detection
notes: Sec 'Methods' & 'Experimental results': 10-fold CV; induces rule sets directly from AQ-10 questions that determine the classification label.

paper: The diagnosis of ASD using multiple machine learning techniques
notes: Sec 'Data pre-processing' & 'Automating ASD diagnosis': 75/25 train-test split; uses A1-A10 to predict Class/ASD reaching 1.00 accuracy.

paper: An Evaluation of Machine Learning Approaches for Early Diagnosis of Autism Spectrum Disorder
notes: Sec 3.2-3.4: 70/30 split and 5-fold CV; preprocessed prior to split; uses AQ-10 items A1-A10 with chi-square selection, achieving 100% on child and 97.14% on adult.

paper: Detection of autism spectrum disorder using multilayer perceptron classifier
notes: Abstract states: 'The samples of ASD have been compiled from toddlers... MLP obtained the best performance, reaching an accuracy rate of 100% in identifying ASD cases.'

paper: Improving Early Autism Detection with Chi-Square Feature Selection, Machine Learning, and Explainable AI
notes: Uses Kaggle/UCI toddler Q-CHAT-10 dataset (N=1054, ref 94); Chi-square feature selection with SVM reaches 100% (perfect) accuracy, precision, recall, and F1.

paper: A Machine Learning Framework for Early-Stage Detection of Autism Spectrum Disorders
notes: Uses UCI/Kaggle AQ-10 and toddler datasets (N=2,154); feature scaling outside folds; AdaBoost achieves 99.25% on toddlers, LDA achieves 99.03% on adults using screening items.

paper: A Framework for Comparison and Interpretation of Machine Learning Classifiers to Predict Autism on the ABIDE Dataset
notes: Sec 'Cross-validation and evaluation': 5-fold CV pooled across 20 sites; does not report site-wise/LOSO split or calibration.

paper: Identification of autism spectrum disorder using deep learning and the ABIDE dataset
notes: Sec 2.3 & 3.1: 10-fold CV on pooled data yields 70%; leave-one-site-out / single-site drops to ~52-65%, demonstrating scanner confound.

paper: Deriving reproducible biomarkers from multi-site resting-state data: An Autism-based example
notes: Sec 2.4 'Evaluation strategy': Thorough LOSO cross-validation across all sites; benchmark for inter-site generalization.

paper: Disease prediction using graph convolutional networks: Application to Autism Spectrum Disorder and Alzheimer's disease
notes: Sec 3.2 'Experimental setup': Population graph links test nodes to training nodes across sites; 10-fold CV.

paper: ASD-DiagNet: A Hybrid Learning Approach for Detection of Autism Spectrum Disorder Using fMRI Data
notes: Sec 'Materials and methods': 10-fold CV; synthetic data augmentation performed on full dataset; peak accuracy reported on single isolated center.

paper: Multisite functional connectivity MRI classification of autism: ABIDE results
notes: Sec 'Classification Analysis': Leave-one-out CV across 964 subjects; site mean offset subtraction; emphasizes multisite accuracy drops from single-site 80-90% down to 60.0%.

paper: Functional connectivity classification of autism identifies highly predictive brain features but falls short of biomarker standards
notes: Sec 2.4 'Classification analysis': External validation between NIMH and ABIDE cohorts; shows neuroimaging biomarkers drop compared to behavioral questionnaires.

paper: Edge-variational Graph Convolutional Networks for Uncertainty-aware Disease Prediction
notes: Sec 3 'Experiments': 10-fold CV; implements Monte Carlo Edge Dropout to quantify prediction uncertainty.

paper: A Novel Transfer Learning Approach to Enhance Deep Neural Network Classification of Brain Functional Connectomes
notes: Sec 'Experiments': Deep transfer learning across individual sites; acknowledges multi-site heterogeneity.

paper: Diagnosing Autism Spectrum Disorder from Brain Resting-State Functional Connectivity Patterns Using a Deep Neural Network with a Novel Feature Selection Method
notes: Sec 'Classification Framework': 5-fold nested CV on single-site UM cohort; achieves 86.36% but lacks multi-site generalization.

paper: Classification of Autism Spectrum Disorder Using Random Support Vector Machine Cluster
notes: Sec 'Materials and methods': Small sample (N=84); test set evaluated during cluster selection, producing inflated 96.15% on 26 subjects.

paper: A heterogeneous graph convolutional attention network method for classification of autism spectrum disorder
notes: Sec 'Methods' & 'Experimental results': 10-fold CV randomly pooling subjects across 17 sites without site-wise isolation.

paper: Insights from an autism imaging biomarker challenge: Promises and threats to biomarker discovery
notes: Sec 2 'Challenge design': International challenge evaluating algorithms on unseen test centers and external EU-AIMS cohort.

paper: Automated Detection of Autism Spectrum Disorder Using a Convolutional Neural Network
notes: Sec 'Classification Results': 10-fold CV achieves 70.22%; Table 7 reports leave-site-out across 17 sites, showing accuracy variation from 53% to 75%.

paper: Identifying Autism from Resting-State fMRI Using Long Short-Term Memory Networks
notes: Sec 3 'Experiments and Results': 10-fold CV across 17 sites; no site harmonization or leave-site-out evaluation.

paper: Distance Metric Learning using Graph Convolutionn Networks: Application to Functional Brain Networks
notes: Sec 4.1 'ABIDE dataset': 720 train, 151 test split; introduces site-matching regularizer into Siamese GCN.

paper: Brain Network Transformer
notes: Sec 5 'Experiments': 70/10/20 train/val/test split across 17 sites; tests on ABCD external cohort.
